payload.longDescription: It is recommended to enable backup on the FSLogix Storage Account. Ensuring the user profiles are resilient will allow user data and experience to be consistent through outages.

items.title: Configure user nodepool count

payload.description: Configure user nodepool count
payload.longDescription: Configuring the user node pool with at least two nodes is essential for applications needing high availability, ensuring they remain operational and accessible without interruption.

learnMoreLink.name: Azure Well-Architected Framework review for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)

items.title: Create a validation host pool

payload.description: Create a validation host pool
payload.longDescription: Validation host pools let you monitor service updates before the service applies them to your standard or non-validation environment.

learnMoreLink.name: Configure a host pool as a validation environment

items.title: Define Failover Guidelines

payload.description: Define Failover Guidelines
payload.longDescription: In case of a regional failure, an IoT Hub can failover to a second region, automatically or manually, to ensure your application continues working.

learnMoreLink.name: IoT Hub high availability and disaster recovery

items.title: Define alternate VM SKUs

payload.description: Define alternate VM SKUs
payload.longDescription: Azure Databricks planning should include VM SKU swap strategies for capacity issues. VMs are regional, and allocation failures may occur, shown by a "CLOUD PROVIDER" error.

items.title: Monitor Memory Utilization to ensure sufficient resources for workloads

payload.description: Monitor Memory Utilization to ensure sufficient resources for workloads
payload.longDescription: Ensure sufficient memory resources to prevent host resource exhaustion in Azure VMware Solution. It uses vSphere DRS and vSphere HA for dynamic workload management. Yet, continuous memory use over 95% leads to disk swapping, affecting workloads.

items.title: Configure diverse VPN Site links to different VPN concentrators on-premises

payload.description: Configure diverse VPN Site links to different VPN concentrators on-premises
payload.longDescription: Deploying active-active VPN concentrators leverages the High Availability capabilities of the VPN Gateway on Virtual Hubs using a fully-meshed topology with four IPSec tunnels.

items.title: Ensure Oracle Database@Azure Infrastructure is updated in a rolling manner.

payload.description: Ensure Oracle Database@Azure Infrastructure is updated in a rolling manner.
payload.longDescription:
Non-rolling maintenance incurs a downtime.
Automatic infrastructure maintenance occurs quarterly, with Oracle notifying you of the date and time weeks in advance. You can modify the scheduled date and time before maintenance starts.

items.title: Enable Soft Delete to protect your data

payload.description: Enable Soft Delete to protect your data
payload.longDescription: The soft delete option enables data recovery if mistakenly deleted, while the Lock feature prevents the accidental deletion of the storage account itself, ensuring additional security and data integrity measures.

items.title: Disable anonymous pull access

payload.description: Disable anonymous pull access
payload.longDescription: By default, Azure container registry requires authentication for pull/push actions. Enabling anonymous pull access exposes all content for public read actions. This applies to all repositories, potentially allowing unrestricted access if repository-scoped tokens are used.

items.title: Leverage Global provisioned deployment to ensure high and predictable throughput

payload.description: Leverage Global provisioned deployment to ensure high and predictable throughput
payload.longDescription: Global provisioned deployments provide reserved model processing capacity for high and predictable throughput using Azure global infrastructure. Suitable for applications requiring lower latency variance at large workload usage. Provides cost savings.
payload.potentialBenefits: Low latency variance, high throughputs, business continuity

items.title: Implement Autonomous Recovery Service in Azure for ODAA backup strategy

payload.description: Implement Autonomous Recovery Service in Azure for ODAA backup strategy
payload.longDescription:
Enable OCI-managed backup to Autonomous Recovery Service in Azure for data protection.
ARS provides automated, policy-based backups with continuous validation.

learnMoreLink.name: Business continuity and disaster recovery considerations for Oracle Database@Azure

items.title: Update AKS tier to Standard or Premium

payload.description: Update AKS tier to Standard or Premium
payload.longDescription: Production AKS clusters require the Standard or Premium tier for a financially backed SLA and enhanced node scalability, as the free service lacks these features. Use the Premium tier for mission-critical workloads.

items.title: Enable Virtual Network Flow Logs

payload.description: Enable Virtual Network Flow Logs
payload.longDescription: Improves monitoring and security for Azure and Hybrid connectivity
payload.potentialBenefits: Improves monitoring and security for Azure connectivity

items.title: Implement a multi-region BCDR Plan

payload.description: Implement a multi-region BCDR Plan
payload.longDescription: It is recommended to adopt a multi-region deployment (active-active or active-passive) for AVD. Each region should contain at least identity, name resolution, AVD management resources, and session hosts in case of a primary region outage.

items.title: Ensure PAYG AOAI models leverage Global Standard deployment

payload.description: Ensure PAYG AOAI models leverage Global Standard deployment
payload.longDescription: Global Standard leverages Azure's global infrastructure to route traffic to the best available data center for customer's real-time inference requests. It provides the highest default quota and eliminates the need to load balance across multiple resources. Optimized for low to medium volume usage.

items.title: Migrate from Application Insights instrumentation keys to connection strings

payload.description: Migrate from Application Insights instrumentation keys to connection strings
payload.longDescription: Application Insights is changing from global ingestion endpoints to regional endpoints that use connection strings. Connection strings make telemetry ingestion more reliable by removing dependencies on global ingestion endpoints. Transition to connection string-based ingestion before 31 March 2025.

learnMoreLink.name: Migrate from Application Insights instrumentation keys to connection strings

items.title: Verify vSAN FTT configuration aligns with the cluster size

payload.description: Verify vSAN FTT configuration aligns with the cluster size
payload.longDescription: The Azure VMware Solution's service SLA is influenced by vSAN storage policies, which change based on cluster size. For clusters over 6 hosts, an FTT-2 policy (RAID-1 or RAID-6) is advised. FTT refers to the Fault Tolerance feature.

items.title: Ensure synchronous data replication (SYNC mode) between primary and secondary VM nodes

payload.description: Ensure synchronous data replication (SYNC mode) between primary and secondary VM nodes
payload.longDescription: High availability for databases should be implemented using database native replication technologies and the data should be replicated synchronously that is in SYNC mode from primary database to a stand-by node.
payload.potentialBenefits: Ensures high availability for SAP data

items.title: Store configuration as app settings for Web Site Slots

payload.description: Store configuration as app settings for Web Site Slots
payload.longDescription: Use app settings for configuration and define them in Resource Manager templates or via PowerShell to facilitate part of an automated deployment/update process for improved reliability.

learnMoreLink.name: Configure web apps in Azure App Service

items.title: Ensure unique hostid set for Function App

payload.description: Ensure unique hostid set for Function App
payload.longDescription: A host ID must be between 1 and 32 characters, contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes, not start or end with a dash, and not contain consecutive dashes. The host ID value should be unique for all apps/slots you're running.

learnMoreLink.name: Resource naming restrictions - Azure Resource Manager

items.title: Store configuration as app settings for Web Sites

payload.description: Store configuration as app settings for Web Sites
payload.longDescription: Use app settings for configuration and define them in Resource Manager templates or via PowerShell to facilitate part of an automated deployment/update process for improved reliability.

learnMoreLink.name: Configure web apps in Azure App Service

items.title: Ensure ExpressRoute Direct is not over-subscribed

payload.description: Ensure ExpressRoute Direct is not over-subscribed
payload.longDescription: Provisioning ExpressRoute circuits on a 10-Gbps or 100-Gbps ExpressRoute Direct resource up to 20-Gbps or 200-Gbps is possible but not recommended for resiliency. If an ExpressRoute Direct port fails, and circuits are using full capacity, the remaining port won't handle the extra load.

items.title: Deploy a PAYG instance of the model with provisioned throughput to manage overflow effectively

payload.description: Deploy a PAYG instance of the model with provisioned throughput to manage overflow effectively
payload.longDescription: Provisioned Throughput offers pre-allocated capacity for consistent workloads, while Pay-as-You-Go charges for actual usage, ideal for variable workloads. During overflow, the Pay-as-You-Go instance manages excess load, ensuring service efficiency.
payload.potentialBenefits: PAYG model balances cost and performance and helps scale

items.title: Configure AVD Insights workbook

payload.description: Configure AVD Insights workbook
payload.longDescription: Configure AVD insights workbook template to monitor and troubleshoot AVD workloads across metrics, logs, events, and more. Both Production and DR workloads should be enabled with AVD Insights.

items.title: Ensure ExpressRoute's physical links connect to distinct network edge devices

payload.description: Ensure ExpressRoute's physical links connect to distinct network edge devices
payload.longDescription: Microsoft or the ExpressRoute provider always ensures physical redundancy in their services. It's essential to maintain this level of physical redundancy (two devices, two links) from the ExpressRoute peering location to your network for optimal performance and reliability.

learnMoreLink.name: Designing for high availability with ExpressRoute

items.title: Deploy Azure Bastion into the virtual network in secondary Azure region

payload.description: Deploy Azure Bastion into the virtual network in secondary Azure region
payload.longDescription: Azure Bastion is a single-region service, if the primary region becomes unavailable, the Bastion resource will also be unavailable. To ensure disaster recovery, it is recommended to deploy Azure Bastion into separate virtual networks across different regions.
payload.potentialBenefits: Provides disaster recovery from regional outages

items.title: Databricks runtime version is not latest or is not LTS version

payload.description: Databricks runtime version is not latest or is not LTS version
payload.longDescription: Databricks recommends migrating workloads to the latest or LTS version of its runtime for enhanced stability and support. If on Runtime 11.3 LTS or above, move directly to the latest 12.x version. If below, first migrate to 11.3 LTS, then to the latest 12.x version as per the migration guide.

items.title: Use failover group customer managed policy

payload.description: Use failover group customer managed policy
payload.longDescription: When using failover groups, setting your failover policy to customer managed is highly recommended as it keeps you in control of when to initiate a failover.

items.title: Automate DR infrastructure build or pre-deploy DR resources

payload.description: Automate DR infrastructure build or pre-deploy DR resources
payload.longDescription: Automate the build of disaster recovery (DR) infrastructure (or pre-deploy DR resources) and streamline SAP service recovery as much as possible.

items.title: Plan for backend maintenance by using connection draining

payload.description: Plan for backend maintenance by using connection draining
payload.longDescription: Using connection draining for backend maintenance ensures graceful removal of backend pool members during updates or health issues. It's enabled via Backend Setting and applies to all members during rule creation.

items.title: Use Managed Disks for VM disks

payload.description: Use Managed Disks for VM disks
payload.longDescription: Azure is retiring unmanaged disks on September 30, 2025. Users should plan the migration to avoid disruptions and maintain service reliability.

learnMoreLink.name: Migrate your Azure unmanaged disks by Sep 30, 2025

items.title: Recover from Structured Streaming query failures

payload.description: Recover from Structured Streaming query failures
payload.longDescription: Structured Streaming ensures fault-tolerance and data consistency in streaming queries. With Azure Databricks workflows, you can set up your queries to automatically restart after failure, picking up precisely where they left off.

items.title: Ensure to create Machine Learning Compute resources in secondary region

payload.description: Ensure to create Machine Learning Compute resources in secondary region
payload.longDescription: Create compute resources for training a Machine Learning model in selected regions. Ensure both regions have sufficient compute quota for dynamic scaling. Customers must configure HA across zones for attached compute resources like AKS, Azure Databricks, Container Instances.

learnMoreLink.name: Failover for business continuity and disaster recovery

items.title: Deploy VMSS across availability zones with VMSS Flex

payload.description: Deploy VMSS across availability zones with VMSS Flex
payload.longDescription: When creating VMSS, implement availability zones as a protection measure for your applications and data against the rare event of datacenter failure.

learnMoreLink.name: Create a Virtual Machine Scale Set that uses Availability Zones

items.title: Do not Store any Production Data in Default DBFS Folders

payload.description: Do not Store any Production Data in Default DBFS Folders
payload.longDescription: Driven by security and data availability concerns, each Azure Databricks Workspace comes with a default DBFS designed for system-level artifacts like libraries and Init scripts, not for production data.

items.title: Enable Cross Region Restore for your GRS Recovery Services Vault

payload.description: Enable Cross Region Restore for your GRS Recovery Services Vault
payload.longDescription: Cross Region Restore enables the restoration of Azure VMs in a secondary, Azure paired region, facilitating drills for audit or compliance and allowing recovery of VMs or disks in the event of a primary region disaster. It is an opt-in feature available exclusively for GRS vaults.

items.title: Use Zone-redundant or Geo-zone-redundant Backup storage redundancy

payload.description: Use Zone-redundant or Geo-zone-redundant Backup storage redundancy
payload.longDescription: Configuring zone redundancy option for backups copies your backup file synchronously across three Azure availability zones in the primary region. If Geo is selected, then it copies your data asynchronously three times to a single physical location in the paired secondary region.

items.title: Validate VM functionality with a Site Recovery test failover to check performance at target

payload.description: Validate VM functionality with a Site Recovery test failover to check performance at target
payload.longDescription: Perform a test failover to validate your BCDR strategy and ensure that your applications are functioning correctly in the target region without impacting your production environment. Test your Disaster Recovery plan periodically without any data loss or downtime, using test failovers.
payload.potentialBenefits: Ensures BCDR plan accuracy and VM performance

items.title: Monitor health for ExpressRoute gateway

payload.description: Monitor health for ExpressRoute gateway
payload.longDescription: Set up monitoring and alerts for ExpressRoute Gateway. Create alert rule for ensuring promptly response to critical events such as exceeding packets per second, exceeding BGP routes prefixes, Gateway overutilization and high frequency in route changes.
payload.potentialBenefits: Detection and mitigation to avoid disruptions.

items.title: Avoid using ExpressRoute circuits for VNet to VNet communication

payload.description: Avoid using ExpressRoute circuits for VNet to VNet communication
payload.longDescription: While multiple VNets can connect via the same ExpressRoute gateway, Microsoft recommends using alternatives like VNet peering, Azure Firewall, NVA, Azure Route Server, site-to-site VPN, virtual WAN, or SD-WAN for VNet-to-VNet communication to optimize network performance and management.

learnMoreLink.name: About ExpressRoute virtual network gateways - VNet-to-VNet connectivity

items.title: Backup VMs with Azure Backup service

payload.description: Backup VMs with Azure Backup service
payload.longDescription: Enable backups for your virtual machines with Azure Backup to secure and quickly recover your data. This service offers simple, secure, and cost-effective solutions for backing up and recovering data from the Microsoft Azure cloud.

learnMoreLink.name: What is the Azure Backup service?

items.title: Use Generation 2 virtual machine source image

payload.description: Use Generation 2 virtual machine source image
payload.longDescription: When building Image Templates, use sources for gen 2 VMs. Gen 2 offers more memory, supports >2TB disks, uses UEFI for faster boot/installation, has Intel SGX, and virtualized persistent memory (vPMEM), unlike gen 1's BIOS-based architecture.
payload.potentialBenefits: More memory, supports >2TB disks, faster boot

items.title: Configure logs

payload.description: Configure logs
payload.longDescription: Front Door logs offer comprehensive telemetry on each request, crucial for understanding your solution's performance and responses, especially when caching is enabled, as origin servers might not receive every request.

learnMoreLink.name: Monitor metrics and logs in Azure Front Door

items.title: Use NAT gateway for outbound connectivity to avoid SNAT Exhaustion

payload.description: Use NAT gateway for outbound connectivity to avoid SNAT Exhaustion
payload.longDescription: Prevent connectivity failures due to SNAT port exhaustion by employing NAT gateway for outbound traffic from virtual networks, ensuring dynamic scaling and secure internet connections.

learnMoreLink.name: Use NAT GW for outbound connectivity

items.title: Use a layered storage architecture

payload.description: Use a layered storage architecture
payload.longDescription: Curate data by creating a layered architecture to increase data quality across layers. Start with a raw layer for ingested source data, continue with a curated layer for cleansed and refined data, and finish with a final layer catered to business needs, focusing on security and performance.

items.title: Remove unwanted location constraints from Linux Pacemaker clusters

payload.description: Remove unwanted location constraints from Linux Pacemaker clusters
payload.longDescription: Use the migrate command in a Linux Pacemaker cluster to create a temporary "prefer" location constraint, moving a resource to a specified node for maintenance or testing. This constraint is temporary and should be removed after the task to revert to the original cluster configuration.

items.title: Enable point-in-time restore for GPv2 accounts to safeguard against data loss

payload.description: Enable point-in-time restore for GPv2 accounts to safeguard against data loss
payload.longDescription: Consider enabling point-in-time restore for standard general purpose v2 accounts with flat namespace to protect against accidental deletion or corruption by restoring block blob data to an earlier state.

items.title: Plan and implement IP addressing strategy to meet current and future requirements

payload.description: Plan and implement IP addressing strategy to meet current and future requirements
payload.longDescription:
Design an IP addressing scheme considering current and future Oracle workload needs to prevent conflicts and ensure availability.
Primary, standby, client, and backup subnets should have non-overlapping CIDR ranges for reliable connectivity.

items.title: Monitor health for ExpressRoute gateway

payload.description: Monitor health for ExpressRoute gateway
payload.longDescription: Use Network Insights for monitoring ExpressRoute Gateway's health, including availability, performance, and scalability.

learnMoreLink.name: ExpressRoute monitoring, metrics, and alerts | ExpressRoute gateways

items.title: Configure static routes for session hosts to directly access the AVD control plane subnet

payload.description: Configure static routes for session hosts to directly access the AVD control plane subnet
payload.longDescription: Ensure Route Tables have static routes for session host traffic targeting the AVD control plane to go directly to the internet (next hop). This avoids delays from additional hops or inspections in trusted traffic communication.

items.title: Key vaults should have soft delete enabled

payload.description: Key vaults should have soft delete enabled
payload.longDescription: Key Vault's soft-delete feature enables recovery of deleted vaults and objects like keys, secrets, and certificates. When enabled, marked resources are retained for 90 days, allowing for their recovery, essentially undoing deletion.

items.title: Ensure ExpressRoute Traffic Collector is enabled and configured for Direct or Provider circuits

payload.description: Ensure ExpressRoute Traffic Collector is enabled and configured for Direct or Provider circuits
payload.longDescription: ExpressRoute Traffic Collector samples network flows over ExpressRoute Direct or Service-Provider based circuits, sending flow logs to a Log Analytics workspace for analysis or export to visualization tools/SIEM.
payload.potentialBenefits: Enhanced network flow analysis and DR readiness

items.title: Diagnostic logs in Key Vault should be enabled

payload.description: Diagnostic logs in Key Vault should be enabled
payload.longDescription: Enable logs, set up alerts, and adhere to retention requirements for improved monitoring and security of Key Vault access, detailing the frequency and identity of users.

items.title: Configure Network Watcher Connection monitor

payload.description: Configure Network Watcher Connection monitor
payload.longDescription: Improves monitoring for Azure and Hybrid connectivity
payload.potentialBenefits: Improves monitoring for Azure and Hybrid connectivity

items.title: Create a HCX Snapshot ahead of either a maintenance activity or a crucial HCX operation

payload.description: Create a HCX Snapshot ahead of either a maintenance activity or a crucial HCX operation
payload.longDescription: Use Run command to take a snapshot of HCX Manager before making any critical changes to HCX Manager. Additionally, capture snapshot for HCX Manager before initiating a maintenance activity.

learnMoreLink.name: Take a snapshot of VMware HCX Cloud Manager

items.title: Ensure resilient deployment of key vaults for AVD Host Pools

payload.description: Ensure resilient deployment of key vaults for AVD Host Pools
payload.longDescription: To ensure continuous availability and disaster recovery readiness, provision a secondary Key Vault in a secondary region. In case of a primary region failure, the secondary Key Vault will ensure critical secrets remain accessible for deployments in the secondary region.

items.title: Enable Availability Zones for Service Bus namespaces

payload.longDescription: Availability zones are now enabled by default on new namespaces where possible. Existing namespaces are being migrated to availability zones where possible. The property zoneRedundant might still show as false, even when availability zones has been enabled.

payload.longDescription: The Databricks Terraform provider is a flexible, powerful tool for managing Azure Databricks workspaces and cloud infrastructure.

payload.description: Organize AVD resources using the AVD scale unit model described by the AVD landing zone methodology
payload.longDescription: Follow AVD Landing Zone best practices using multiple resource groups based on resource type and associated shared resources for AVD workloads.

payload.longDescription: SLA is not available for Free tier. Upgrade to the Standard tier to get an SLA of 99.9%
payload.potentialBenefits: High availability, more storage, higher request quota.

payload.longDescription: The Azure Image Builder service lacks availability zones support. Replicating Image Templates to a secondary region will enable the build of new images in secondary region.

items.title: Peer two NVA instances with both Azure Route Server instances

payload.longDescription: To ensure that routes are successfully advertised to Route Server and to configure high availability, peer two NVA instances with both instances of Route Server. Advertise the same routes to both Route Server instances.

payload.longDescription:
Monitor database metrics such as CPU utilization and memory usage with Azure Monitor, setting alerts for scaling decisions.
Auto-scaling isn't available on Oracle Exadata Database@Azure.
If needed, scale OCPUs on the VM cluster, if Exa infrastructure capacity allows.

learnMoreLink.name: Learn about Manage and monitor Oracle Database@Azure

payload.longDescription: Create Alerts with Azure Monitor for operations like Create or Update Route Table to spot unauthorized/undesired changes in production resources. This setup aids in identifying improper routing changes, including efforts to evade firewalls or access resources from outside.

learnMoreLink.name: Azure activity log - Azure Monitor | Microsoft Learn

items.title: Enable cross region disaster recovery for SQL Managed Instance

payload.longDescription: Consider deploying a failover group for your SQL Managed Instance to enable business continuity in a different Azure region in case of regional outage.
payload.potentialBenefits: Ensure business continuity through regional redundancy.

payload.longDescription: AKS, popular for stateful apps needing backups, can now use Azure Backup to secure clusters and attached volumes through an installed Backup Extension, enabling backup and restore operations via a Backup Vault.

payload.description: Run production workloads on two or more VMs using VMSS Flex
payload.longDescription: Production VM workloads should be deployed on multiple VMs and grouped in a VMSS Flex instance to intelligently distribute across the platform, minimizing the impact of platform faults and updates.

learnMoreLink.name: What has changed with Flexible orchestration mode

items.title: Enable Active-Active VPN Gateways for redundancy

payload.longDescription: The active-active mode is available for all SKUs except Basic, allowing for two Gateway IP configurations and two public IP addresses, enhancing redundancy and traffic handling. Mission Critical workloads should use dual ExpressRoutes instead of VPN.

payload.longDescription: Establish a process for handling image updates in your AVD environment. Instead of updating session hosts directly, create a new version of the updated image. This involves creating and configuring a golden image with the necessary updates and configurations.

items.title: Migrate from classic alerts to built-in Azure Monitor alerts for Azure Recovery Services Vaults

payload.description: Migrate from classic alerts to built-in Azure Monitor alerts for Azure Recovery Services Vaults
payload.longDescription: Classic alerts for Recovery Services vaults in Azure Backup will be retired on 31 March 2026.

payload.longDescription: Set an alert for when the node count in Azure VMware Solution Private Cloud hits or exceeds 90 hosts, enabling timely planning for a new private cloud.

items.title: Activate Bidirectional Forwarding Detection on edge devices for faster failover

payload.longDescription: Enabling BFD over ExpressRoute speeds up link failure detection between MSEE devices and routers configured for ExpressRoute (CE/PE), applicable over both customer and Partner Edge routing devices with managed Layer 3 service.

payload.longDescription: Define reliability and recovery targets for the components, the flows, and the overall solution. Use the defined targets to build the health model. The health model defines what healthy, degraded, and unhealthy states look like.

learnMoreLink.name: Ways to monitor Azure NetApp Files | Microsoft Learn

payload.longDescription: Azure Capacity Reservations ensure high availability for virtual machines by reserving compute capacity in advance within a specific region or availability zone. This guarantees that VMs will have the necessary resources during peak demand or maintenance events, enhancing reliability and uptime.

items.title: Monitor health for v-Hubs

payload.longDescription: Set up monitoring and alerts for v-Hubs. Create alert rule for ensuring promptly response to changes in BGP status and Data processed by v-Hubs.
payload.potentialBenefits: Detection and mitigation to avoid disruptions.

payload.longDescription: Configure GRS to ensure that your database meets its availability and durability targets even in the face of failures or disasters.

payload.longDescription: A-series VMs are tailored for entry-level workloads like development and testing, including use cases such as development and test servers, low traffic web servers, and small to medium databases.

items.title: Shared disks should only be enabled in clustered servers
