payload.longDescription: Azure NetApp Files snapshot technology ensures stability, scalability, and swift data recoverability without affecting performance. It supports automatic snapshot creation via policies for Azure NetApp Files data.
payload.potentialBenefits: Stable, scalable, swift recovery, no perf impact

learnMoreLink.name: How Azure NetApp Files snapshots work | Microsoft Learn

items.title: Use comprehensive monitoring solution for AOAI service

payload.description: Use comprehensive monitoring solution for AOAI service
payload.longDescription: Implementing a comprehensive monitoring solution for AOAI involves using Azure Monitor to track API usage, performance metrics, and security events. This setup helps optimize performance, manage costs, and ensure compliance by providing detailed insights into model usage and potential issues.
payload.potentialBenefits: Optimize performance and compliance with detailed insights

items.title: When AccelNet is enabled, you must manually update the GuestOS NIC driver

payload.description: When AccelNet is enabled, you must manually update the GuestOS NIC driver
payload.longDescription: When Accelerated Networking is enabled, the default Azure VNet interface in GuestOS is swapped for a Mellanox, and its driver comes from a 3rd party. Marketplace images have the latest Mellanox drivers, but post-deployment, updating the driver is the user's responsibility.

items.title: Enable Availability Zones on Premium API Management instances

payload.description: Enable Availability Zones on Premium API Management instances
payload.longDescription: Zone redundancy for APIM instances ensures the gateway and control plane (Management API, developer portal, Git configuration) are replicated across datacenters in physically separated zones, boosting resilience to zone failures.

learnMoreLink.name: Ensure API Management availability and reliability

items.title: RE:02 Identify and rate user and system flows

payload.description: RE:02 Identify and rate user and system flows
payload.longDescription: Identify and rate user and system flows. Use a criticality scale based on your business requirements to prioritize the flows.

items.title: Deploy Data Guard observer in different Availability zones for high availability

payload.description: Deploy Data Guard observer in different Availability zones for high availability
payload.longDescription: Deploy Data Guard observer nodes in different AZs and make sure that an observer node will remain available if anything happens to the Production deployment.
payload.potentialBenefits: Data Guard observer automates database failover.

learnMoreLink.name: Business continuity and disaster recovery considerations for Oracle Database@Azure

items.title: Device Identities are exported to a secondary region

payload.description: Device Identities are exported to a secondary region
payload.longDescription: Device Identities should be copied to the failover region IoT Hub for all IoT devices to ensure connectivity in case of a failover. Manual Failover to another region is quicker (RTO), suitable for mission critical workloads.

learnMoreLink.name: Import and export IoT Hub device identities in bulk

items.title: Migrate to Application Gateway v2

payload.description: Migrate to Application Gateway v2
payload.longDescription: Use Application Gateway v2 for built-in features like autoscaling, static VIPs, Azure KeyVault integration for better traffic management and performance, unless v1 is necessary.

items.title: Separate web apps from web APIs

payload.description: Separate web apps from web APIs
payload.longDescription: If your solution includes both a web front end and a web API, decomposing them into separate App Service apps facilitates solution decomposition by workload, allowing for independent scaling. Initially, you can deploy both in the same plan and separate them for independent scaling when necessary.

learnMoreLink.name: Resiliency checklist for specific Azure services

items.title: RE:07 Implement self-preservation and self-healing measures

payload.description: RE:07 Implement self-preservation and self-healing measures
payload.longDescription: Strengthen the resiliency and recoverability of your workload by implementing self-preservation and self-healing measures. Self-healing capabilities help you avoid downtime by building in failure detection and automatic corrective actions to respond to different failure types.

items.title: Ensure FUNCTIONS_WORKER_RUNTIME is set properly

payload.description: Ensure FUNCTIONS_WORKER_RUNTIME is set properly
payload.longDescription: The FUNCTIONS_WORKER_RUNTIME setting in the Function App configuration should be set to the appropriate value based on the language you are using. This setting is used to determine the language worker that will be used to execute your functions.

items.title: Ensure Time-To-Live (TTL) is set appropriately to ensure RTOs can be met

payload.description: Ensure Time-To-Live (TTL) is set appropriately to ensure RTOs can be met
payload.longDescription: Azure DNS allows the Time-To-Live (TTL) for record sets in the zone to be set to a value between 1 and 2147483647 seconds. You should ensure that the TTL for the DNS record sets in your DNS Zones are set appropriately to meet your RTO targets.
payload.potentialBenefits: Ensures that no cached DNS records exist past RTO targets

items.title: Use dedicated file share for App attach and include the storage in the disaster recovery plan

payload.description: Use dedicated file share for App attach and include the storage in the disaster recovery plan
payload.longDescription: App Attach packages should be on a separate share from profiles and backed up. Requirements vary based on the number of packaged applications. Test your applications to understand your needs. Ensure the file share is in the same Azure region as your session hosts.

items.title: RE:08 Design a reliability testing strategy

payload.description: RE:08 Design a reliability testing strategy
payload.longDescription: Test resiliency and availability scenarios by applying the principles of chaos engineering in your test and production environments. Use testing to ensure that your graceful degradation implementation and scaling strategies are effective by performing active malfunction and simulated load testing.

items.title: Automatically rescue invalid or nonconforming data with Databricks Auto Loader or Delta Live Tables

payload.description: Automatically rescue invalid or nonconforming data with Databricks Auto Loader or Delta Live Tables
payload.longDescription: Invalid or nonconforming data can crash workloads dependent on specific data formats. Best practices recommend filtering such data at ingestion to improve end-to-end resilience, ensuring no data is lost or missed.

items.title: RE:06 Design for data partitioning

payload.description: RE:06 Design for data partitioning
payload.longDescription: Partitioning data improves scalability, reduces contention, and optimizes performance. Implement data partitioning to divide data by usage pattern.

items.title: Configure system nodepool count

payload.description: Configure system nodepool count
payload.longDescription: The system node pool should be configured with a minimum node count of three to ensure critical system pods are resilient to node outages.

items.title: Enable Logging-Cluster log delivery

payload.description: Enable Logging-Cluster log delivery
payload.longDescription: When creating a Databricks cluster, you can set a log delivery location for the Spark driver, worker nodes, and events. Logs are delivered every 5 mins and archived hourly. Upon cluster termination, all generated logs until that point are guaranteed to be delivered.

items.title: Configure storage auto-grow

payload.description: Configure storage auto-grow
payload.longDescription: Configure storage auto-grow to prevent the server from running out of storage and becoming read-only.
payload.potentialBenefits: Scale storage automatically to meet increasing demand

learnMoreLink.name: Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server service tiers - Storage auto grow

items.title: Secure compute resource capacity for critical VM roles in DR region

payload.description: Secure compute resource capacity for critical VM roles in DR region
payload.longDescription: Ensure compute resource availability for critical VM roles in a DR region using a warm standby approach or Azure's On-demand Capacity Reservation. Warm standby keeps VMs running in the DR region, while On-demand Capacity Reservation reserves compute capacity without running VMs.

items.title: Enable Automatic Repair Policy on Azure Virtual Machine Scale Sets

payload.description: Enable Automatic Repair Policy on Azure Virtual Machine Scale Sets
payload.longDescription: Enabling automatic instance repairs in Azure Virtual Machine Scale Sets enhances application availability through a continuous health check and maintenance process.

learnMoreLink.name: Automatic instance repairs for Azure Virtual Machine Scale Sets

items.title: Ensure Autoscale feature has been enabled

payload.description: Ensure Autoscale feature has been enabled
payload.longDescription: Azure Application Gateways v2 are always deployed in a highly available fashion with multiple instances by default. Enabling autoscale ensures the service is not reliant on manual intervention for scaling.

items.title: Avoid using Classic Azure Front Door

payload.description: Avoid using Classic Azure Front Door
payload.longDescription: Azure Front Door standard is ~45% cheaper then AFD classic and has many additional benefits. Classic is also scheduled to be retired on March 31, 2027.
payload.potentialBenefits: Costs savings and additional supported features

learnMoreLink.name: Compare pricing between Azure Front Door tiers

items.title: A minimum subnet size of /24 is recommended for Application Gateway v2 subnets.

payload.description: A minimum subnet size of /24 is recommended for Application Gateway v2 subnets.
payload.longDescription: Application Gateway (Standard_v2 or WAF_v2 SKU) can support up to 125 instances (125 instance IP addresses + 1 private frontend IP configuration + 5 Azure reserved). A minimum subnet size of /24 is recommended.

learnMoreLink.name: Azure Application Gateway infrastructure configuration | Microsoft Learn

items.title: Upgrade VMSS Image versions scheduled to be deprecated or already retired

payload.description: Upgrade VMSS Image versions scheduled to be deprecated or already retired
payload.longDescription: Ensure current versions of images are in use to avoid disruption after image deprecation. Please review the publisher, offer, sku information of the VM to ensure you are running on a supported image. Enable Auto Guest Patching or Image Upgrades, to get notifications about image deprecation.
payload.potentialBenefits: Avoid disruptions by updating VMSS images.

items.title: Ensure zone redundancy is enabled in supported regions

payload.description: Ensure zone redundancy is enabled in supported regions
payload.longDescription: When using the Azure portal, zone redundancy is automatically enabled. However, some Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools may default this to false. To ensure replication of metadata and events across data centers in an availability zone, always verify that zone redundancy is enabled.
payload.potentialBenefits: Enhanced fault tolerance for Event Hub

items.title: Use Health Probes to detect backend availability

payload.description: Use Health Probes to detect backend availability
payload.longDescription: Using custom health probes enhances understanding of backend availability and facilitates monitoring of backend services for any impact.

items.title: Configure jobs for automatic retries and termination

payload.description: Configure jobs for automatic retries and termination
payload.longDescription: Use Databricks and MLflow for deploying models as Spark UDFs for job scheduling, retries, autoscaling. Model serving offers scalable infrastructure, processes models using MLflow, and serves them via REST API using serverless compute managed in Databricks cloud.

items.title: Set minimum instance count to 2 for app service

payload.description: Set minimum instance count to 2 for app service
payload.longDescription: App Service should be configured with a minimum of two instances for production workloads. If apps have a longer warmup time a minimum of three instances should be used.

learnMoreLink.name: Ultimate guide to running healthy apps in the cloud

items.title: Ensure both connections of an ExpressRoute are configured in active-active mode

payload.description: Ensure both connections of an ExpressRoute are configured in active-active mode
payload.longDescription: Operating both connections of an ExpressRoute circuit in active-active mode enhances high availability as the Microsoft network will load balance the traffic across the connections on a per-flow basis.
payload.potentialBenefits: Improved high availability and load balancing

learnMoreLink.name: Designing for high availability with ExpressRoute - Active-active connections

items.title: Enable HA with zone redundancy

payload.description: Enable HA with zone redundancy
payload.longDescription: Enable HA with zone redundancy on flexible server instances to deploy a standby replica in a different zone, offering automatic failover capability for improved reliability and disaster recovery.

learnMoreLink.name: High availability concepts in Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server

items.title: Migrate App Service to availability Zone Support

payload.description: Migrate App Service to availability Zone Support
payload.longDescription: Azure's feature of deploying App Service plans across availability zones enhances resiliency and reliability by ensuring operation during datacenter failures, providing redundancy without needing different regions, thus minimizing downtime and maintaining uninterrupted services.

learnMoreLink.name: Migrate App Service to availability zone support

items.title: Create Application insights for Machine learning workspace in both the regions

payload.description: Create Application insights for Machine learning workspace in both the regions
payload.longDescription: Create Application Insights for machine learning workspace in both regions. To adjust the data-retention period, update and manage data retention in a Log Analytics workspace.
payload.potentialBenefits: Provides monitoring and data retention in DR region

learnMoreLink.name: Data collection, retention, and storage in Application Insights

items.title: Ensure separate log analytics workspaces for Prod and DR

payload.description: Ensure separate log analytics workspaces for Prod and DR
payload.longDescription: Having separate Log Analytics ensures that your DR environment is fully operational for visibility of the metrics, performance, and other auditing tools your workload teams will rely on in the event of an incident.

items.title: Evaluate regional isolation for workspaces

payload.description: Evaluate regional isolation for workspaces
payload.longDescription: Move workspaces to in-region control plane for increased regional isolation. Identify current control plane region using the workspace URL and nslookup. When region from CNAME differs from workspace region and an in-region control is available, consider migration using tools provided below.

items.title: Ensure that models are deployed using Global batch for large scale processing

payload.description: Ensure that models are deployed using Global batch for large scale processing
payload.longDescription: Global batch efficiently handles large-scale tasks within 24 hours. Submit requests in a single file, with a separate quota to protect online workloads. Key uses: data processing, content generation, document review, customer support automation, data extraction, NLP tasks, and marketing.
payload.potentialBenefits: Cost effective faster turnaround for large-scale processing.

items.title: Monitor changes in Network Security Groups with Azure Monitor

payload.description: Monitor changes in Network Security Groups with Azure Monitor
payload.longDescription: Create Alerts with Azure Monitor for operations like creating or updating Network Security Group rules to catch unauthorized/undesired changes to resources and spot attempts to bypass firewalls or access resources from the outside.

items.title: Deploy ANF volumes in the same availability zone with Azure compute and other services

payload.description: Deploy ANF volumes in the same availability zone with Azure compute and other services
payload.longDescription: Azure NetApp Files' availability zone (AZ) volume placement feature lets you deploy volumes in the same AZ with Azure compute and other services to have within AZ latency and share the same AZ failure domain.
payload.potentialBenefits: Within AZ latency and tolerate failure of other AZ

learnMoreLink.name: Manage availability zone volume placement for Azure NetApp Files | Microsoft Learn

items.title: RE:01 Design your workload to align with business objectives

payload.description: RE:01 Design your workload to align with business objectives
payload.longDescription: Design your workload to align with business objectives and avoid unnecessary complexity or overhead. Use a practical and balanced approach to make design decisions that deliver the desired results. Contain your design to the necessities to reduce inefficiencies and potential problems.

items.title: Use NAT Gateway instead of Outbound Rules for Production Workloads

payload.description: Use NAT Gateway instead of Outbound Rules for Production Workloads
payload.longDescription: Outbound rules for Standard Public Load Balancer involve manual port allocation for backend pools, limiting scalability and risk of SNAT port exhaustion. NAT Gateway is recommended for its dynamic scaling and secure internet connectivity.

learnMoreLink.name: Resiliency checklist for specific Azure services- Azure Load Balancer

items.title: Enable container health probes

payload.description: Enable container health probes
payload.longDescription: Enable container health probes to monitor the health of your container apps and ensure that unhealthy containers are restarted automatically.

learnMoreLink.name: Health probes for Azure Container Apps

items.title: Enable versioning for accidental modification and keep the number of versions below 1000

payload.description: Enable versioning for accidental modification and keep the number of versions below 1000
payload.longDescription: Consider enabling versioning for Azure Storage Accounts to recover from accidental modifications or deletions and manage blob operation latency. Microsoft advises maintaining fewer than 1000 versions per blob to optimize performance. Lifecycle management can help delete old versions automatically.

items.title: Monitor "AZFW Latency Probe" metric

payload.description: Monitor "AZFW Latency Probe" metric
payload.longDescription: Using the Azure Firewall latency probe metric to monitor sustained latency over 30ms (accounting for normal spikes) can help identify when firewall instance CPU utilization is under stress, potentially indicating performance issues

learnMoreLink.name: Azure Well-Architected Framework review - Azure Firewall

items.title: Enable the cluster auto-scaler on an existing cluster

payload.description: Enable the cluster auto-scaler on an existing cluster
payload.longDescription: The cluster auto-scaler in AKS adjusts node counts based on pod resource needs and available capacity, enabling scaling as per demand to prevent outages.

learnMoreLink.name: Use the Cluster Autoscaler on AKS

items.title: RE:10 Design a reliable monitoring and alerting strategy

payload.description: RE:10 Design a reliable monitoring and alerting strategy
payload.longDescription: Measure and publish the solution's health indicators. Continuously capture uptime and other reliability data from across the workload and also from individual components and key flows.

items.title: Enable VPN gateway service health

payload.description: Enable VPN gateway service health
payload.longDescription: VPN gateway leverages service health to inform users about both planned and unplanned maintenance, ensuring they are notified about modifications to their VPN connectivity. Mission Critical workloads should use dual ExpressRoutes instead of VPN.

items.title: Deploy two or more circuits in different peering locations when using stretched clusters

payload.description: Deploy two or more circuits in different peering locations when using stretched clusters
payload.longDescription: Azure VMware Solution vSAN stretched clusters cover 2 Availability Zones plus a third for witness. Use ExpressRoute for added resilience by deploying two circuits in different locations. With Global Reach, create a mesh topology by connecting on-premises circuits to Azure's managed circuits.

items.title: Configure Dead-letter to save events that cannot be delivered

payload.description: Configure Dead-letter to save events that cannot be delivered
payload.longDescription: Event Grid may not deliver an event within a specific time or after several attempts, leading to dead-lettering where undelivered events are sent to a storage account.

learnMoreLink.name: Azure Event Grid delivery and retry

items.title: Enable availability zones

payload.description: Enable availability zones
payload.longDescription: When availability zones are configured, Azure Cosmos DB intelligently distributes the 4 replicas of your data across all available zones. It ensures that your Azure Cosmos DB can withstand an outage in one availability zone and remain fully operational throughout.

learnMoreLink.name: High availability in Azure Cosmos DB

items.title: Use pod topology spread constraints to ensure that pods are spread across different nodes or zones

payload.description: Use pod topology spread constraints to ensure that pods are spread across different nodes or zones
payload.longDescription: Enhance availability and reliability by using pod topology spread constraints to control pod distribution based on node or zone topology, ensuring pods are spread across your cluster.
payload.potentialBenefits: Ensures high availability and efficient use

items.title: Create regular backups

payload.description: Create regular backups
payload.longDescription: To recover from a failure, regular backups are needed. The Databricks Labs project migrate lets admins create backups by exporting workspace assets using the Databricks CLI/API. These backups help in restoring or migrating workspaces.

items.title: Ensure a unique OU is used when deploying host pools with domain joined session hosts

payload.description: Ensure a unique OU is used when deploying host pools with domain joined session hosts
payload.longDescription: Place domain joined session hosts VMs in unique OUs. Segregate Prod and DR units for environment-specific settings. This ensures targeted configurations for session hosts, including FSLogix, session controls, etc.

learnMoreLink.name: Configure the VMs and install Active Directory Domain Services

items.title: Avoid combining Traffic Manager and Front Door

payload.description: Avoid combining Traffic Manager and Front Door
payload.longDescription: For most solutions, choose either Azure Front Door for content caching, CDN, TLS termination, and WAF, or Traffic Manager for simple global load balancing.

items.title: Enable Azure Virtual Machine Scale Set Application Health Monitoring

payload.description: Enable Azure Virtual Machine Scale Set Application Health Monitoring
payload.longDescription: Monitoring application health in Azure Virtual Machine Scale Sets is crucial for deployment management. It supports rolling upgrades such as automatic OS-image upgrades and VM guest patching, leveraging health monitoring for upgrading.

learnMoreLink.name: Using Application Health extension with Virtual Machine Scale Sets

items.title: Monitor all blob storage accounts

payload.description: Monitor all blob storage accounts
payload.longDescription: For critical applications and business processes relying on Azure, monitoring and alerts are crucial. Resource logs are only stored after creating a diagnostic setting to route logs to specified locations, requiring selection of log categories to collect.

items.title: Configure Service Health Alerts

payload.description: Configure Service Health Alerts
payload.longDescription: Service health gives a personalized health view of Azure services and regions used, offering the best place for notifications on outages, planned maintenance, and health advisories by knowing the services used.

learnMoreLink.name: Configure alerts for service health events

items.title: Configure monitoring and alerting for ExpressRoute circuits

payload.description: Configure monitoring and alerting for ExpressRoute circuits
payload.longDescription: Use Network Insights for monitoring ExpressRoute circuit availability, QoS, and throughput. Set alerts based on Azure Monitor Baseline Alerts for availability, QoS metrics, and throughput metrics exceeding specific thresholds.

items.title: Configure host pool scheduled agent updates

payload.description: Configure host pool scheduled agent updates
payload.longDescription: Create up to two maintenance windows for the Azure Virtual Desktop agent, side-by-side stack, and Geneva Monitoring agent to get updated so that updates don't happen during peak business hours.

learnMoreLink.name: Scheduled Agent Updates for Azure Virtual Desktop host pools

items.title: Ensure Resource Group and its Resources are located in the same Region

payload.description: Ensure Resource Group and its Resources are located in the same Region
payload.longDescription: Ensure resource locations align with their resource group to manage resources during regional outages. ARM stores resource data, which if in an unavailable region, could halt updates, rendering resources read-only.

items.title: Ensure checkpoints are used for AI training models

payload.description: Ensure checkpoints are used for AI training models
payload.longDescription: Checkpoint optimization for large model training is crucial for disaster recovery. It reduces training time, increases reliability, improves cost efficiency, enhances resource utilization, and supports scalability by saving model states periodically to resume training from the last saved point.
payload.potentialBenefits: Reduces costs, training time and increases reliability.

items.title: Connect ExpressRoute gateway with circuits from diverse peering locations

payload.description: Connect ExpressRoute gateway with circuits from diverse peering locations
payload.longDescription: For improved reliability, each ExpressRoute gateway should connect to at least two circuits, with each circuit sourced from a different peering location. This setup ensures diverse connectivity paths, enhancing resilience and minimizing service disruption risks.
payload.potentialBenefits: Enhanced resilience through diverse connectivity paths

learnMoreLink.name: Designing for disaster recovery with ExpressRoute private peering

items.title: Deploy two or more DNS servers across availability zones in each region with AVD session hosts.

payload.description: Deploy two or more DNS servers across availability zones in each region with AVD session hosts.
payload.longDescription: Deploy custom DNS servers on Azure VMs across availability zones in the same region as session hosts. This removes on-premises dependencies and improves performance by shortening the name resolution path.

items.title: Use Azure Boost VMs for Maintenance sensitive workload VMs

payload.description: Use Azure Boost VMs for Maintenance sensitive workload VMs
payload.longDescription: If the workload is Maintenance sensitive, consider Azure Boost compatible VMs. Azure Boost is designed to lessen the impact on customers when Azure maintenance activities occur on the host.

items.title: Turn on continuous availability for ANF

payload.description: Turn on continuous availability for ANF
payload.longDescription:
Turn on Continuous Availability if using Azure Netapp Files.
Verify the number of users connecting to each file share to make sure the SMB path can handle the number of file connections.

items.title: Enable service-managed failover for multi-region accounts with single write region

payload.description: Enable service-managed failover for multi-region accounts with single write region
payload.longDescription: Cosmos DB boasts high uptime and resiliency. Even so, issues may arise. With Service-Managed failover, if a region is down, Cosmos DB automatically switches to the next available region, requiring no user action.

learnMoreLink.name: Manage an Azure Cosmos DB account by using the Azure portal

items.title: Evaluate multi-region write capability

payload.description: Evaluate multi-region write capability
payload.longDescription: Multi-region writes enable high availability but require careful consistency and conflict resolution. Using Bounded Staleness is an anti-pattern, as replication lag increases latency and coordination overhead. This setup undermines scalability, impacting performance and availability.

learnMoreLink.name: Distribute data globally with Azure Cosmos DB

items.title: Configure a Pacemaker cluster for SAP ASCS high availability

payload.description: Configure a Pacemaker cluster for SAP ASCS high availability
payload.longDescription: For the ASCS-Pacemaker (Central Server Instance), ensure that the Pacemaker cluster configuration parameters are correctly set up for SAP ASCS high availability.

items.title: Enable Soft Delete for Recovery Services Vaults in Azure Backup

payload.description: Enable Soft Delete for Recovery Services Vaults in Azure Backup
payload.longDescription: With soft delete, if backup data is deleted, the backup data is retained for 14 additional days, allowing the recovery of that backup item with no data loss with no cost to you. Soft delete is enabled by default. Disabling this feature isn't recommended.

items.title: Monitor VPN gateway connections and health

payload.description: Monitor VPN gateway connections and health
payload.longDescription: Set up monitoring and alerts for Virtual Network Gateway health to utilize a variety of metrics for ensuring operational efficiency and prompt response to any disruptions. Mission Critical workloads should use dual ExpressRoutes instead of VPN.

items.title: Enable Stretched Clusters for Multi-AZ Availability of the vSAN Datastore

payload.description: Enable Stretched Clusters for Multi-AZ Availability of the vSAN Datastore
payload.longDescription: For Azure VMware Solution, enabling Stretched Clusters offers 99.99% SLA, synchronous storage replication (RPO=0), and spreads vSAN datastore across two AZs. Must be done at initial setup, needing double quota due to extension across AZs.

items.title: Back Up Your Keys

payload.description: Back Up Your Keys
payload.longDescription: It is highly recommended to use Azure Key Vault (AKV) to store encryption keys related to Always Encrypted configurations, however it is not required. If you are not using AKV, then ensure that your keys are properly backed up and stored in a secure manner.

items.title: Subscription core quota should be increased if Node pool auto-scale settings exceed the quota

payload.description: Subscription core quota should be increased if Node pool auto-scale settings exceed the quota
payload.longDescription: Node pool settings should not exceed the subscription core quota to ensure AKS can scale out nodes efficiently, meeting increased demand while reducing resource constraints and potential service disruptions.

items.title: Configure pod disruption budgets (PDBs)

payload.description: Configure pod disruption budgets (PDBs)
payload.longDescription: A Pod Disruption Budget is a Kubernetes resource configuring the minimum number or percentage of pods that should remain available during disruptions like maintenance or scaling, ensuring a minimum number of pods are always available in the cluster.

items.title: Recover ETL jobs based on Delta time travel

payload.description: Recover ETL jobs based on Delta time travel
payload.longDescription: Despite thorough testing, a production job can fail or yield unexpected data. Sometimes, repairs are done by adding jobs post-issue identification and pipeline correction.
payload.potentialBenefits: Easy rollback and fix for ETL jobs

items.title: Deploy to a staging slot

payload.description: Deploy to a staging slot
payload.longDescription: Create a deployment slot for staging to deploy updates, verify them, and ensure all instances are warmed up before production swap, reducing bad update chances. An LKG slot allows easy rollback to a previous good deployment if issues arise later, enhancing reliability.

learnMoreLink.name: Set up staging environments in Azure App Service

items.title: Use virtual network links to link global Private DNS Zones to VNETs in two or more regions

payload.description: Use virtual network links to link global Private DNS Zones to VNETs in two or more regions
payload.longDescription: DNS private zones are resilient to regional outages because zone data is globally available. Resource records in a private zone are automatically replicated across regions. Linking a Private DNS Zone to VNETs in multiple regions increases availability and resiliency.
payload.potentialBenefits: Ensures seamless failover for DNS during a regional outage

items.title: Use replica sets for resiliency or geolocation in Microsoft Entra Domain Services

payload.description: Use replica sets for resiliency or geolocation in Microsoft Entra Domain Services
payload.longDescription:
To improve the resiliency of a Microsoft Entra Domain Services managed domain, or deploy to additional geographic locations close to your applications, you can use replica sets.
You can add a replica set to any peered virtual network in any Azure region that supports Domain Services.
payload.potentialBenefits: The replica sets provide geographical resiliency.

learnMoreLink.name: Create and use replica sets for resiliency or geolocation in Microsoft Entra Domain Services

items.title: Use constraints and data expectations

payload.description: Use constraints and data expectations
payload.longDescription: Delta tables verify data quality automatically with SQL constraints, triggering an error for violations. Delta Live Tables enhance this by defining expectations for data quality, utilizing Python or SQL, to manage actions for record failures, ensuring data integrity and compliance.

items.title: Use multiple head nodes for HPC Pack

payload.description: Use multiple head nodes for HPC Pack
payload.longDescription: Establish a cluster with a minimum of two head nodes. In the event of a head node failure, the active HPC Service will be automatically transferred from the affected head node to another functioning one.

items.title: Use Repository namespaces

payload.description: Use Repository namespaces
payload.longDescription: Using repository namespaces allows a single registry to be shared across multiple groups and deployments within an organization, supporting nested namespaces for group isolation. However, repositories are managed independently, not hierarchically.

learnMoreLink.name: Registry best practices - use repository namespaces

items.title: Use Azure Traffic Manager to route search requests via geo-located clients for failover redundancy.

payload.description: Use Azure Traffic Manager to route search requests via geo-located clients for failover redundancy.
payload.longDescription: Azure Traffic Manager enhances redundancy by routing search requests to geo-located clients. If a primary search client or region fails, Traffic Manager redirects requests to a backup client in another region. This setup ensures continuous availability and seamless failover for search services.

items.title: Use Ephemeral OS Disks for AKS VMSS Node Pools

payload.description: Use Ephemeral OS Disks for AKS VMSS Node Pools
payload.longDescription: Ephemeral OS disks on AKS offer lower read/write latency due to local attachment, eliminating the need for replication seen with managed disks. This enhances performance and speeds up cluster operations such as scaling or upgrading due to quicker re-imaging and boot times.
payload.potentialBenefits: Lower latency, faster re-imaging and booting

items.title: Monitor Performance

payload.description: Monitor Performance
payload.longDescription: Use Application Insights to monitor app performance and load behavior, offering real-time insights, issue diagnosis, and root-cause analysis. It supports ASP.NET, ASP.NET Core, Java, and Node.js on Azure App Service, now with built-in monitoring.

items.title: Plan for a multi-regional deployment of Azure Machine Learning and associated resources

payload.description: Plan for a multi-regional deployment of Azure Machine Learning and associated resources
payload.longDescription: Ensure you have a recovery strategy defined. Check regional availability and paired regions. Machine Learning doesn't have auto failover. Therefore, you must design a strategy that encompasses the workspace and all its dependencies, such as Key Vault, Azure Storage, and Container Registry.

items.title: Migrate VMs using availability sets to VMSS Flex

payload.description: Migrate VMs using availability sets to VMSS Flex
payload.longDescription: While availability sets are not scheduled for immediate deprecation, they are planned to be deprecated in the future. Migrate workloads from VMs to VMSS Flex for deployment across zones or within the same zone across different fault domains (FDs) for better reliability.

learnMoreLink.name: Migrate deployments and resources to Virtual Machine Scale Sets in Flexible orchestration

items.title: Ensure that each SAP production system is designed for high availability across availability zones

payload.description: Ensure that each SAP production system is designed for high availability across availability zones
payload.longDescription: Use Azure Availability Zones to protect SAP systems against data center failures. Ensure high availability by deploying across multiple zones. If deployment across zones isn't possible, refer to Microsoft's guidance for high availability options for SAP workloads.

learnMoreLink.name: High Availability Deployment Options for SAP

items.title: Monitor Private DNS Zones health and set up alerts

payload.description: Monitor Private DNS Zones health and set up alerts
payload.longDescription: Use Azure Monitor to monitor Private DNS Zone query volume, record set count, and capacity metrics for Record Set, Virtual Network Link, and Virtual Network Link with auto-registration. Create alerts based on Azure Monitor Baseline Alerts for these metrics that exceed specific thresholds.

items.title: Use standard network features for production in Azure NetApp Files

payload.description: Use standard network features for production in Azure NetApp Files
payload.longDescription: Standard network feature in Azure NetApp Files enhances IP limits and VNet capabilities, including network security groups, user-defined routes on subnets, and diverse connectivity options.

learnMoreLink.name: Guidelines for Azure NetApp Files network planning | Microsoft Learn

items.title: Ensure AOAI models are deployed using Data Zone Standard for data residency requirements

payload.description: Ensure AOAI models are deployed using Data Zone Standard for data residency requirements
payload.longDescription: Data zone deployments route customer traffic to the highest availability data center within the defined data zone, ensuring data at rest remains within the Azure OpenAI resource geography. This approach offers increased quota limits and ensures data processing occurs within the specified data zone.
payload.potentialBenefits: Enforce data residency and compliance standards

items.title: Monitor Azure DDoS Protection Plan metrics

payload.description: Monitor Azure DDoS Protection Plan metrics
payload.longDescription: Azure DDoS Plan metrics differentiate packets and bytes by tags: Dropped (packets scrubbed by DDoS), Forwarded (packets to VIP not filtered), and No tag (total packets, sum of dropped and forwarded).

items.title: Deploy active-active VPN concentrators on your premises

payload.description: Deploy active-active VPN concentrators on your premises
payload.longDescription: Deploying active-active VPN concentrators and Azure VPN Gateways maximizes resilience and availability using a fully-meshed topology with four IPSec tunnels. Mission Critical workloads should use dual ExpressRoutes instead of VPN.

learnMoreLink.name: Dual-redundancy active-active VPN gateways for both Azure and on-premises networks

items.title: Configure API management service in multiple Azure regions

payload.description: Configure API management service in multiple Azure regions
payload.longDescription: API Management multi-region deployment will help to reduce request latency perceived by geographically distributed API consumers and improves service availability if one region goes offline.
payload.potentialBenefits: Improve latency and provides business continuity

learnMoreLink.name: Deploy API Management instance to multiple Azure regions

items.title: Upgrade Persistent Volumes using in-tree drivers to Azure CSI drivers

payload.description: Upgrade Persistent Volumes using in-tree drivers to Azure CSI drivers
payload.longDescription: From Kubernetes 1.26, Azure Disk and Azure File in-tree drivers are deprecated in favor of CSI drivers. Existing deployments remain operational but untested; users should switch to CSI drivers for new features and SKUs.

items.title: Automatically grow and shrink HPC Pack cluster resources

payload.description: Automatically grow and shrink HPC Pack cluster resources
payload.longDescription: By deploying Azure "burst" nodes (both Windows and Linux) in your HPC Pack cluster or creating your HPC Pack cluster in Azure, you can automatically grow or shrink the cluster's resources such as nodes or cores according to the workload on the cluster.

items.title: Create Image Versions replicas in secondary region

payload.description: Create Image Versions replicas in secondary region
payload.longDescription: On multi-region deployments, replicate Image Versions to a secondary region to ensure disaster recovery capability. This ensures that the Image Versions are available in the secondary region in case of a disaster in the primary region.

items.title: Use Device Provisioning Service

payload.description: Use Device Provisioning Service
payload.longDescription: Device Provisioning Service (DPS) enables easy redistribution of IoT devices for scaling and availability, allowing devices to be reassigned and not bound to specific IoT Hub instances. Devices in IoT Hubs using DPS should be verified for DPS utilization.

learnMoreLink.name: IoT Hub Device Provisioning Service (DPS) terminology

items.title: Use Standard or Premium tier

payload.description: Use Standard or Premium tier
payload.longDescription: Choose Standard/Premium Azure App Service Plan for robust apps with advanced scaling, high availability, better performance, and multiple slots, ensuring resilience and continuous operation.

learnMoreLink.name: Resiliency checklist for specific Azure services

items.title: Enable custom maintenance schedule

payload.description: Enable custom maintenance schedule
payload.longDescription: Use custom maintenance schedule on flexible server instances to select a preferred time for service updates to be applied.

learnMoreLink.name: Scheduled maintenance in Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server

items.title: Enable backup for data protection in Azure NetApp Files

payload.description: Enable backup for data protection in Azure NetApp Files
payload.longDescription: Azure NetApp Files offers a fully managed backup solution enhancing long-term recovery, archiving, and compliance.

learnMoreLink.name: Understand Azure NetApp Files backup | Microsoft Learn

items.title: Enable Log Analytics data export to GRS or GZRS

payload.description: Enable Log Analytics data export to GRS or GZRS
payload.longDescription: Data export in a Log Analytics workspace to an Azure Storage account enhances data protection against regional failures by using geo-redundant (GRS) or geo-zone-redundant storage (GZRS), mainly for compliance and integration with other Azure services and tools.
payload.potentialBenefits: Enhances compliance and regional fault tolerance

learnMoreLink.name: Log Analytics workspace data export in Azure Monitor

items.title: Enable AZ support in AI Search by configuring multiple replicas to your search service

payload.description: Enable AZ support in AI Search by configuring multiple replicas to your search service
payload.longDescription: Availability zones are used when adding multiple replicas to your search service. Each replica is assigned to a different zone in the region. If there are more replicas than zones, they are distributed as evenly as possible across the available zones.

items.title: Configure Image version replica count per region.

payload.description: Configure Image version replica count per region.
payload.longDescription: You can set a different replica count in each target region, based on the scale needs for the region. For every 20 VMs that you create concurrently, we recommend you keep one replica.

items.title: A minimum of three replicas should be kept for production image versions

payload.description: A minimum of three replicas should be kept for production image versions
payload.longDescription: Keeping a minimum of 3 replicas for production images in Azure's Compute Gallery ensures scalability and prevents throttling in multi-VM deployments by distributing VM deployments across different replicas. This reduces the risk of overloading a single replica.

items.title: Configure one or more read replicas

payload.description: Configure one or more read replicas
payload.longDescription: Configure one or more read replicas to ensure that your database meets its availability and durability targets even in the face of failures or disasters.
payload.potentialBenefits: Recover from regional failure and/or disaster

learnMoreLink.name: Read replicas in Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server

items.title: Disable Force strictly even balance across zones to avoid scale in and out fail attempts

payload.description: Disable Force strictly even balance across zones to avoid scale in and out fail attempts
payload.longDescription: Microsoft advises disabling strictly even VM instance distribution across Availability Zones in VMSS to improve scalability and flexibility, noting that uneven distribution may better serve application load demands despite the potential trade-off in resilience.

learnMoreLink.name: Use scale-in policies with Azure Virtual Machine Scale Sets

items.title: Do not use Azure Spot VMs for critical Production workloads

payload.description: Do not use Azure Spot VMs for critical Production workloads
payload.longDescription: Azure Spot VMs are not suitable for critical production workloads needing high availability and reliability. They are meant for fault-tolerant tasks and can be evicted with 30-seconds notice if Azure needs the capacity, with no SLA guarantees.

items.title: If using single-instance VMs all OS and data disks must be Premium SSD or Ultra Disk

payload.description: If using single-instance VMs all OS and data disks must be Premium SSD or Ultra Disk
payload.longDescription: For single-instance VMs, both OS and data disks must be either Premium SSD or Ultra Disk to achieve the single-instance SLA of 99.9% availability.

items.title: Enable VM Insights

payload.description: Enable VM Insights
payload.longDescription: VM Insights monitors VM and scale set performance, health, running processes, and dependencies. It enhances the predictability of application performance and availability by pinpointing performance bottlenecks and network issues, and it clarifies if problems are related to other dependencies.

items.title: Actively manage schemas

payload.description: Actively manage schemas
payload.longDescription: Uncontrolled schema changes can lead to invalid data and failing jobs. Databricks validates and enforces schema through Delta Lake, which prevents bad records during ingestion, and Auto Loader, which detects new columns and supports schema evolution to maintain data integrity.
payload.potentialBenefits: Prevents invalid data and job failures

items.title: Resolve issues with Private Endpoints in non Succeeded connection state

payload.description: Resolve issues with Private Endpoints in non Succeeded connection state
payload.longDescription: A private endpoint has two custom properties, static IP address and the network interface name, which must be set at creation. If not in Succeeded state, there may be issues with the endpoint or associated resource.

items.title: Monitor and create alerting for Azure Route Server

payload.description: Monitor and create alerting for Azure Route Server
payload.longDescription: Monitor Azure Route Server for BGP Peer Status, Count of Routes Advertised to Peer, and Count of Routes Learned from Peer. Create alerts for these metrics to ensure that you are notified of any issues.
payload.potentialBenefits: Be alerted to connectivity issues with Azure Route Server

items.title: Configure monitoring and alerting for NAT gateway

payload.description: Configure monitoring and alerting for NAT gateway
payload.longDescription: Use Network Insights for monitoring and alerting on your NAT gateway.Use Total SNAT connection count metric to determine if you're nearing the connection limit of NAT gateway. Set alerts based on Azure Monitor Baseline Alerts (AMBA) thresholds for NAT Gateway

learnMoreLink.name: What is Azure NAT Gateway metrics and alerts?

items.title: Enable caching to improve performance in Azure API Management

payload.description: Enable caching to improve performance in Azure API Management
payload.longDescription: Response caching can significantly reduce latency for API callers and backend load for API providers.
payload.potentialBenefits: Ensures service continuity and high availability

learnMoreLink.name: Add caching to improve performance in Azure API Management

items.title: Migrate API Management services to Premium SKU to support Availability Zones

payload.description: Migrate API Management services to Premium SKU to support Availability Zones
payload.longDescription: Upgrading the API Management instance to the Premium SKU adds support for Availability Zones, enhancing availability and resilience by distributing services across physically separate locations within Azure regions.

learnMoreLink.name: Change your API Management service tier

items.title: Enable Purge protection for Azure App Configuration

payload.description: Enable Purge protection for Azure App Configuration
payload.longDescription: With Purge protection enabled, soft deleted stores can't be purged in the retention period. If disabled, the soft deleted store can be purged before the retention period expires.
payload.potentialBenefits: Prevent accidental deletion of configuration stores.

items.title: Use at least the Enterprise SKU

payload.description: Use at least the Enterprise SKU
payload.longDescription: You need to use a minimum of Enterprise SKU for your managed domain to support replica sets.
payload.potentialBenefits: The Enterprise SKU enables creation of replica sets.

learnMoreLink.name: Create and use replica sets for resiliency or geolocation in Microsoft Entra Domain Services

items.title: Store encryption keys in Azure Key Vault for Exadata workloads

payload.description: Store encryption keys in Azure Key Vault for Exadata workloads
payload.longDescription: Store Oracle TDE master encryption keys for Exadata workloads in Azure Key Vault to centralize key management, improve security, and support compliance with enterprise-grade controls.
payload.potentialBenefits: Storing keys in AKV improves security and reliability.

learnMoreLink.name: Integrate Oracle Exadata Database@Azure with Azure Key Vault

items.title: Use Zone-redundant ExpressRoute gateway SKUs

payload.description: Use Zone-redundant ExpressRoute gateway SKUs
payload.longDescription: Azure ExpressRoute gateway offers variable SLAs based on deployment in single or multiple availability zones. To deploy virtual network gateways across zones automatically, use zone-redundant gateways for accessing critical, scalable services with increased resilience.

learnMoreLink.name: About ExpressRoute virtual network gateways - Zone-redundant gateway SKUs

items.title: Use HCX Network Extension High Availability

payload.description: Use HCX Network Extension High Availability
payload.longDescription: Enable Network Extension High Availability for appliance failure tolerance in HCX service. It pairs selected appliances for Active Standby configuration, ensuring high availability and quick recovery, keeping configurations in-service despite failures.

items.title: Use deployments with multiple replicas in production applications to guarantee availability

payload.description: Use deployments with multiple replicas in production applications to guarantee availability
payload.longDescription: Configuring multiple replicas in Pod or Deployment manifests stabilizes the number of replica Pods, ensuring that a specified number of identical Pods are always available, thereby guaranteeing their availability.

items.title: Deploy dual Azure VMware Solution clouds in different regions for disaster recovery

payload.description: Deploy dual Azure VMware Solution clouds in different regions for disaster recovery
payload.longDescription: Two Azure VMware Solution private clouds can be deployed in different regions for business continuity, implementing a mesh network topology based on ExpressRoute Gateway Connections and Global Reach Connections.

items.title: Setup DNS cross-region failover using Azure DNS Private Resolvers

payload.description: Setup DNS cross-region failover using Azure DNS Private Resolvers
payload.longDescription: Deploy Azure DNS Private Resolvers across multiple regions to establish cross-region failover.

learnMoreLink.name: Resiliency in Azure DNS Private Resolver

items.title: Configure Resource Health Alerts

payload.description: Configure Resource Health Alerts
payload.longDescription: Configure Resource Health Alerts for all applicable resources to stay informed about the current and historical health status of your Azure resources. They notify you when these resources have a change in their health status.

items.title: Enable traffic analytics in Virtual Network Flow Logs configuration

payload.description: Enable traffic analytics in Virtual Network Flow Logs configuration
payload.longDescription: Improves monitoring, security and troubleshooting for Azure and Hybrid connectivity

items.title: Enable zone redundancy for Azure SQL Database to achieve high availability and resiliency

payload.description: Enable zone redundancy for Azure SQL Database to achieve high availability and resiliency
payload.longDescription: By default, Azure SQL Database premium tier provisions multiple copies within the same region. For geo redundancy, databases can be set as Zone Redundant, distributing copies across Azure Availability Zones to maintain availability during regional outages.

items.title: Do not create more than 4000 Citrix VDA servers per subscription

payload.description: Do not create more than 4000 Citrix VDA servers per subscription
payload.longDescription: A Citrix Managed Azure subscription supports VMs with VDA for app/desktop delivery, excluding other machines like Cloud Connectors. When close to the limit, signaled by a dashboard notification, and with sufficient licenses, request another subscription. Can't exceed the given limits for catalogs.

items.title: Use Databricks Workflows and built-in recovery

payload.description: Use Databricks Workflows and built-in recovery
payload.longDescription: Databricks Workflows enable efficient error recovery in multi-task jobs by offering a matrix view for issue examination. Fixes can be applied to initiate repair runs targeting only failed and dependent tasks, preserving successful outcomes and thereby saving time and money.
payload.potentialBenefits: Saves time and money with smart recovery

items.title: Use Redirect connection type to accelerate application access

payload.description: Use Redirect connection type to accelerate application access
payload.longDescription: Redirect mode enables direct connectivity to the instance bypassing the local gateway component and resulting in improved latency and throughput. Redirect mode applies to the VNet-local endpoint only, while the public and private endpoint will always operate in Proxy connection mode.

items.title: Ensure the standard FSLogix configuration is deployed

payload.description: Ensure the standard FSLogix configuration is deployed
payload.longDescription: Ensure all session hosts have the standard FSLogix configuration deployed. Regularly validate settings for consistency and alignment with best practices.

items.title: Configure Azure CNI networking for dynamic allocation of IPs or use CNI overlay

payload.description: Configure Azure CNI networking for dynamic allocation of IPs or use CNI overlay
payload.longDescription: Azure CNI enhances cluster IP and network management, allowing dynamic IP allocation, scalable subnets, direct pod-VNET connectivity, and supports diverse network policies for pods and nodes with Azure Network Policies and Calico, optimizing network efficiency and security
payload.potentialBenefits: Dynamic IP allocation, scalable subnets, direct VNET access

items.title: Ensure there is a robust monitoring and alerting solution in place for the entire DR solution

payload.description: Ensure there is a robust monitoring and alerting solution in place for the entire DR solution
payload.longDescription: Implement robust monitoring and alerting for SAP on Azure, covering DR for databases, central services, applications, and shared file systems. Given SAP's complexity, a comprehensive monitoring strategy is crucial for effective DR replication and rapid issue response.
payload.potentialBenefits: Improved DR oversight and rapid issue response

items.title: Integrate LDAPS Identity with dual sources for enhanced NSX and vCenter security

payload.description: Integrate LDAPS Identity with dual sources for enhanced NSX and vCenter security
payload.longDescription: Ensure two external identity sources are configured for NSX and vCenter Server. The VMware vCenter Server and NSX Manager use these for authentication with external identities.

learnMoreLink.name: Set an external identity source for vCenter

items.title: Document and test DR procedure ensure it meets RPO and RTO targets

payload.description: Document and test DR procedure ensure it meets RPO and RTO targets
payload.longDescription: Document DR procedures for each SAP layer: database, central services, application servers, and shared file systems. Include configuration, failover mechanisms, and recovery steps. Test various failure scenarios to ensure the DR strategy meets RPO/RTO targets and provides seamless failover.

items.title: Ensure endpoint configured to (All World) for geographic profiles

payload.description: Ensure endpoint configured to (All World) for geographic profiles
payload.longDescription: For geographic routing, traffic is directed to endpoints based on specific regions. If a region fails, without a predefined failover, configuring an endpoint to "All (World)" for geographic profiles can prevent traffic black holes, ensuring service remains available.
payload.potentialBenefits: Avoids traffic black holing, ensures availability

items.title: Use Standard SKU and Zone-Redundant IPs when applicable

payload.description: Use Standard SKU and Zone-Redundant IPs when applicable
payload.longDescription: Public IP addresses in Azure can be of standard SKU, available as non-zonal, zonal, or zone-redundant. Zone-redundant IPs are accessible across all zones, resisting any single zone failure, thereby providing higher resilience.

items.title: Enable auto heal for Functions App

payload.description: Enable auto heal for Functions App
payload.longDescription: Auto Heal allows you to mitigate your apps when it runs into unexpected situations like HTTP server errors, resource exhaustion, etc. You can configure different triggers based on your need and choose to recycle the app to recover it from a bad state.

learnMoreLink.name: Announcing the New Auto Healing Experience in App Service Diagnostics - Azure App Service

items.title: Deploy Azure Firewall across multiple availability zones

payload.description: Deploy Azure Firewall across multiple availability zones
payload.longDescription: Azure Firewall offers different SLAs depending on its deployment; in a single availability zone or across multiple, potentially improving reliability and performance.

learnMoreLink.name: Azure Well Architected Framework - Azure Firewall

items.title: Enable auto-scale for production workloads on API Management services

payload.description: Enable auto-scale for production workloads on API Management services
payload.longDescription: Use API Management with auto-scale for high availability in workloads that experience variable traffic patterns. There are several limitations with auto-scale, so review the documentation to ensure it meets your requirements.

learnMoreLink.name: Setting up auto-scale for Azure API Management

items.title: Ensure ODAA infrastructure is in Available state under normal operations

payload.description: Ensure ODAA infrastructure is in Available state under normal operations
payload.longDescription:
ODAA Exadata infrastructures can be in a number of states during its lifecycle (Available, Failed, Maintenance In Progress, Provisioning, Terminated, Terminating and Updating).
Ensure that the infrastructure is in Available state under normal operations.

items.title: Ensure Function App runs a supported version

payload.description: Ensure Function App runs a supported version
payload.longDescription: Beginning on December 13, 2022, function apps running on versions 2.x and 3.x of the Azure Functions runtime have reached the end of life (EOL) of extended support. We highly recommend you migrating your function apps to version 4.x of the Functions runtime.

items.title: Monitor your Azure SQL MI Managed Instance in near-real time to detect reliability incidents

payload.description: Monitor your Azure SQL MI Managed Instance in near-real time to detect reliability incidents
payload.longDescription: Monitoring and alerting are an important part of database operations. When working with Azure SQL Managed Instance, make use of Azure Monitor and Database watcher to ensure that you capture relevant database metrics.

learnMoreLink.name: Azure SQL Managed Instance monitoring options

items.title: Deploy Azure Bastion across Availability Zones

payload.description: Deploy Azure Bastion across Availability Zones
payload.longDescription: Azure Bastion provides secure operational access to workload components. By distributing your Bastion resource across multiple availability zones, you can enhance the resiliency and reliability of your production workloads.
payload.potentialBenefits: Provide high availability and resilience to failures

items.title: Deploy Application Gateway in a zone-redundant configuration

payload.description: Deploy Application Gateway in a zone-redundant configuration
payload.longDescription: Deploying Application Gateway in a zone-aware configuration ensures continued customer access to services even if a specific zone goes down, as services in other zones remain available.

items.title: Enable HA with zone redundancy

payload.description: Enable HA with zone redundancy
payload.longDescription: Enable HA with zone redundancy on flexible server instances to deploy a standby replica in a different zone, offering automatic failover capability for improved reliability and disaster recovery.

learnMoreLink.name: Overview of high availability with Azure Database for PostgreSQL

items.title: Schedule updates by setting a maintenance window

payload.description: Schedule updates by setting a maintenance window
payload.longDescription: Azure Cache for Redis allows for specifying maintenance windows. A maintenance window allows you to control the days and times of a week during which the VMs hosting your cache can be updated.

items.title: Connect on-prem networks to Azure critical workloads via multiple ExpressRoutes peering locations

payload.description: Connect on-prem networks to Azure critical workloads via multiple ExpressRoutes peering locations
payload.longDescription: Ensure resilient connectivity by connecting on-premises networks to Azure through multiple ExpressRoutes, each originating from distinct peering locations, to provide alternate data paths in case of a peering location failure.

learnMoreLink.name: Designing for disaster recovery with ExpressRoute private peering

items.title: Implement Oracle Data Guard replication across availability zones

payload.description: Implement Oracle Data Guard replication across availability zones
payload.longDescription: Oracle Database@Azure follows a Silver-level reference architecture that provides HA by default however it is vulnerable to AZ failures. Gold-level adds Data Guard replication across AZs via Automated DG or manual setup. Use SYNC for zero data loss or ASYNC when performance is constrained.
payload.potentialBenefits: Ensure business continuity in case of zonal failure.

learnMoreLink.name: Business continuity and disaster recovery considerations for Oracle Database@Azure

items.title: Configures Pods Liveness, Readiness, and Startup Probes

payload.description: Configures Pods Liveness, Readiness, and Startup Probes
payload.longDescription: AKS kubelet controller uses liveness probes to validate containers and applications health, ensuring the system knows when to restart a container based on its health status.

items.title: Use Delta Live Tables enhanced autoscaling

payload.description: Use Delta Live Tables enhanced autoscaling
payload.longDescription: Databricks enhanced autoscaling optimizes cluster utilization by automatically allocating cluster resources based on workload volume, with minimal impact on the data processing latency of your pipelines.
payload.potentialBenefits: Optimized resource use and minimal latency

items.title: Avoid NC and NC_Promo series Azure VMs for machine learning quotas; migrate to newer versions

payload.description: Avoid NC and NC_Promo series Azure VMs for machine learning quotas; migrate to newer versions
payload.longDescription: Avoid selecting NC and NC_Promo series Azure virtual machines for machine learning VM quotas and make sure to migrate to newer versions.
payload.potentialBenefits: Avoid service disruption, longer term support

learnMoreLink.name: Migration Guide for GPU Compute Workloads in Azure

items.title: Replicate VMs using Azure Site Recovery

payload.description: Replicate VMs using Azure Site Recovery
payload.longDescription: Replicating Azure VMs via Site Recovery entails continuous, asynchronous disk replication to a target region. Recovery points are generated every few minutes, ensuring a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) in minutes.

items.title: Make use of SMB continuous availability for supported applications

payload.description: Make use of SMB continuous availability for supported applications
payload.longDescription: Certain SMB applications need SMB Transparent Failover for maintenance without interrupting server connectivity. Azure NetApp Files provides this through SMB Continuous Availability for applications like Citrix App Layering, FSLogix user/profile containers, Microsoft SQL Server, MSIX app attach.

learnMoreLink.name: Do I need to take special precautions for SMB-based applications? | Microsoft Learn

items.title: Configure Diagnostic Settings for all network security groups

payload.description: Configure Diagnostic Settings for all network security groups
payload.longDescription: Resource Logs are not collected and stored until you create a diagnostic setting and route them to one or more locations.

items.title: Configure 2-4 PIPs for SNAT Port utilization

payload.description: Configure 2-4 PIPs for SNAT Port utilization
payload.longDescription: Configure a minimum of two to four public IP addresses per Azure Firewall to avoid SNAT exhaustion. Azure Firewall offers SNAT for all outbound traffic to public IPs, providing 2,496 SNAT ports for each additional PIP.

learnMoreLink.name: Azure Well-Architected Framework review - Azure Firewall

items.title: Use zone-redundant storage for persistent volumes when running multi-zone AKS

payload.description: Use zone-redundant storage for persistent volumes when running multi-zone AKS
payload.longDescription: ZRS ensures data replication across three zones, protecting against zonal outages. It's available for Azure Disks, Container Storage, Files, and Blob by setting the SKU to ZRS in storage classes, enhancing multi-zone AKS clusters from v1.29.

items.title: Connect ExpressRoute gateway with circuits from diverse peering locations

payload.description: Connect ExpressRoute gateway with circuits from diverse peering locations
payload.longDescription: For improved reliability, each ExpressRoute gateway should connect to at least two circuits, with each circuit sourced from a different peering location. This setup ensures diverse connectivity paths, enhancing resilience and minimizing service disruption risks.
payload.potentialBenefits: Enhanced resilience through diverse connectivity paths

learnMoreLink.name: Designing for disaster recovery with ExpressRoute private peering

items.title: Implement rate-limiting across ExpressRoute Direct Circuits to optimize network flow

payload.description: Implement rate-limiting across ExpressRoute Direct Circuits to optimize network flow
payload.longDescription: Rate limiting controls traffic volume between on-premises networks and Azure via ExpressRoute Direct, applying to private or Microsoft peering. It distributes port bandwidth, ensures stability, and prevents congestion, with steps outlined for enabling on circuits.

learnMoreLink.name: Rate limiting for ExpressRoute Direct circuits (Preview)

items.title: Manually install FSLogix updates

payload.description: Manually install FSLogix updates
payload.longDescription: Ensure a process to regularly check and update FSLogix agent. Upgrade to the latest version promptly to address bugs and meet support requirements. FSLogix releases hotfixes to resolve issues impacting deployments. Keeping FSLogix updated is crucial for support and reliability.

items.title: Monitor Azure Container Registry with Azure Monitor

payload.description: Monitor Azure Container Registry with Azure Monitor
payload.longDescription: Monitoring Azure resources using Azure Monitor enhances their availability, performance, and operation. Azure Container Registry, a full-stack monitoring service, provides features for Azure and other cloud and on-premises resources.

items.title: Deploy multiple domain controllers across availability zones in each region with AVD session hosts.

payload.description: Deploy multiple domain controllers across availability zones in each region with AVD session hosts.
payload.longDescription: Deploy multiple domain controllers on Azure VMs across availability zones with AVD session hosts. This removes on-premises dependencies and improves performance with a shorter authentication path. This doesn't apply to Microsoft Entra ID or Entra Domain Services joined session hosts.

items.title: Back Up Your Keys

payload.description: Back Up Your Keys
payload.longDescription: It is highly recommended to use Azure Key Vault (AKV) to store encryption keys related to Always Encrypted configurations, however it is not required. If you are not using AKV, then ensure that your keys are properly backed up and stored in a secure manner.

items.title: Enable auto-scale for production workloads on Service Bus namespaces

payload.description: Enable auto-scale for production workloads on Service Bus namespaces
payload.longDescription: Use Service Bus with auto-scale for high availability. The Premium SKU supports auto-scale, ensuring that the resources are automatically scaled based on the load.

items.title: Use Delta Lake for higher reliability

payload.description: Use Delta Lake for higher reliability
payload.longDescription: Delta Lake is an open source storage format enhancing data lakes' reliability with ACID transactions, schema enforcement, and scalable metadata handling.

items.title: Convert Classic Deployments

payload.description: Convert Classic Deployments
payload.longDescription: Classic Application Insights retires in February 2024. To minimize disruption to existing application monitoring scenarios, transition to workspace-based Application Insights before 29 February 2024.

learnMoreLink.name: Migrate an Application Insights classic resource to a workspace-based resource

items.title: Ensure virtual networks have route tables/route server configured for all regions

payload.description: Ensure virtual networks have route tables/route server configured for all regions
payload.longDescription: For high availability connections back to on-premises data centers should consider backup paths across the regions that have been utilized. Ensure redundancy in routing by having a secondary route table in the secondary region.

items.title: Create separate App Service plans for production and test

payload.description: Create separate App Service plans for production and test
payload.longDescription: It is strongly recommended to create separate App Service plans for production and test environments to avoid using slots within your production deployment for testing purposes.
payload.potentialBenefits: Protects prod performance; avoids test impact

learnMoreLink.name: Resiliency checklist for specific Azure services

items.title: Enable AKS Monitoring

payload.description: Enable AKS Monitoring
payload.longDescription: Azure Monitor enables real-time health and performance insights for AKS by collecting events, capturing container logs, and gathering CPU/Memory data from the Metrics API. It allows data visualization using Azure Monitor Container Insights, Prometheus, Grafana, or others.

items.title: Use Failover Group endpoints for database connections

payload.description: Use Failover Group endpoints for database connections
payload.longDescription: When using Failover Groups, it is recommended to connect to the Failover Group endpoint instead of individual database endpoints. This allows for automatic redirection to the secondary database in case of a failover, ensuring high availability.

items.title: Monitor Cosmos DB health and set up alerts

payload.description: Monitor Cosmos DB health and set up alerts
payload.longDescription: Monitoring the availability and responsiveness of Azure Cosmos DB resources and having alerts set up for your workload is a good practice. This ensures you stay proactive in handling unforeseen events.

learnMoreLink.name: Create alerts for Azure Cosmos DB using Azure Monitor

items.title: Mission Critical Workloads should consider using Premium or Ultra Disks

payload.description: Mission Critical Workloads should consider using Premium or Ultra Disks
payload.longDescription: Compared to Standard HDD and SSD, Premium SSD, SSD v2, and Ultra Disks offer improved performance, configurability, and higher single-instance VM uptime SLAs. The lowest SLA of all disks on a VM applies, so it is best to use Premium or Ultra Disks for the highest uptime SLA.
payload.potentialBenefits: Enhanced performance, cost efficiency, and uptime SLA

learnMoreLink.name: Disk type comparison and decision tree

items.title: RE:05 Design for multi-region high availability

payload.description: RE:05 Design for multi-region high availability
payload.longDescription: High availability is a foundational tenet of designing for reliability. A highly available architecture can help you avoid downtime as much as possible and recover efficiently if downtime does occur.

items.title: Implement a regional replication strategy for Oracle to meet your workload requirements
