payload.longDescription: Gold-level reference architecture with Oracle Database@Azure is recommended, meaning that database changes will be replicated via Data Guard (ASYNC replication) to a secondary Oracle Database@Azure instance in a different region.
payload.potentialBenefits: The cloud MAA architecture achieves data protection and DR.

learnMoreLink.name: Business continuity and disaster recovery considerations for Oracle Database@Azure

items.title: Enable Accelerated Networking (AccelNet)

payload.description: Enable Accelerated Networking (AccelNet)
payload.longDescription: Accelerated networking enables SR-IOV to a VM, greatly improving its networking performance by bypassing the host from the data path, which reduces latency, jitter, and CPU utilization for demanding network workloads on supported VM types.
payload.potentialBenefits: Reduces latency, jitter and CPU use

items.title: Enable Multi Region deployments for AI Search

payload.description: Enable Multi Region deployments for AI Search
payload.longDescription: Azure AI Search lacks automatic failover. For continuity and global reach, deploy multiple services in different regions. Sync data via indexers or REST APIs, and manage routing with Azure Traffic Manager.

items.title: Design SAP shared file systems for high availability, utilizing availability zones when possible

payload.description: Design SAP shared file systems for high availability, utilizing availability zones when possible
payload.longDescription:
SAP shared file systems such as /sapmnt, /usr/trans, interfaces should be made highly available.
In case of Azure File Shares, we recommend that you use ZRS (Zone-redundant storage) and for Azure NetApp Files use Zonal replication for your volumes.

items.title: Use key autorotation for vSAN datastore customer-managed keys

payload.description: Use key autorotation for vSAN datastore customer-managed keys
payload.longDescription: When using customer-managed keys for encrypting vSAN datastores, leveraging Azure Key Vault for central management and accessing them via a managed identity linked to the private cloud is advised. The expiration of these keys can render the vSAN datastore and its associated workloads inaccessible.

items.title: Ensure DNS regions are replicated to avoid single point of failure

payload.description: Ensure DNS regions are replicated to avoid single point of failure
payload.longDescription: Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) integrated DNS/other should target Secondary/Tertiary customer DNS across multi-region zones. If using custom DNS, ensure there are redundant DNS servers to avoid a single point of failure.

items.title: Enable Cross-region replication of Azure NetApp Files volumes

payload.description: Enable Cross-region replication of Azure NetApp Files volumes
payload.longDescription: Azure NetApp Files replication offers data protection by allowing asynchronous cross-region volume replication for application failover in case of regional outages. Volumes can be replicated across regions, not concurrently with cross-zone replication. Note that failover is a manual process.
payload.potentialBenefits: Enhanced data protection and disaster recovery

learnMoreLink.name: Cross-region replication of Azure NetApp Files volumes

items.title: Azure API Management platform version should be stv2

payload.description: Azure API Management platform version should be stv2
payload.longDescription: stv1 instances were deprecated on August 31, 2024. If not migrated to stv2 by then, auto-migration will occur. In some cases, due to technical limitations, services may be shut down in March 2025.

learnMoreLink.name: Azure API Management - stv1 platform retirement (August 2024)

items.title: Enable Cross-zone replication of Azure NetApp Files volumes

payload.description: Enable Cross-zone replication of Azure NetApp Files volumes
payload.longDescription: The cross-zone replication (CZR) feature enables asynchronous data replication between Azure NetApp Files volumes across different availability zones, ensuring data protection and critical application failover in case of zone-wide disasters. Note that failover is a manual process.
payload.potentialBenefits: Enhances disaster recovery across availability zones

learnMoreLink.name: Cross-zone replication of Azure NetApp Files volumes | Microsoft Learn

items.title: RE:05 Design for redundancy

payload.description: RE:05 Design for redundancy
payload.longDescription: Add redundancy at different levels, especially for critical flows. Apply redundancy to the compute, data, network, and other infrastructure tiers in accordance with the identified reliability targets.

items.title: Run jobs in your own dedicated Stream Analytics cluster for increased reliability and security

payload.description: Run jobs in your own dedicated Stream Analytics cluster for increased reliability and security
payload.longDescription: Stream Analytics cluster (dedicated) offers more reliable performance guarantees. All the jobs running on your cluster belong only to you. You can also have access to important features like private endpoints, Auto-Scaling, Vnet Support, etc.

learnMoreLink.name: Overview of Azure Stream Analytics Cluster

items.title: Configure continuous backup mode

payload.description: Configure continuous backup mode
payload.longDescription: Cosmos DB's backup is always on, offering protection against data mishaps. Continuous mode allows for self-serve restoration to a pre-mishap point, unlike periodic mode which requires contacting Microsoft support, leading to longer restore times.

learnMoreLink.name: Continuous backup with point in time restore feature in Azure Cosmos DB

items.title: Ensure that storage accounts are zone or region redundant

payload.description: Ensure that storage accounts are zone or region redundant
payload.longDescription: Redundancy ensures storage accounts meet availability and durability targets amidst failures, weighing lower costs against higher availability. Locally redundant storage offers the least durability at the lowest cost.
payload.potentialBenefits: High availability and durability for storage

items.title: Ensure AVD session hosts connect to control plane & allow UDP ports for RDP shortpath

payload.description: Ensure AVD session hosts connect to control plane & allow UDP ports for RDP shortpath
payload.longDescription: Ensure AVD session hosts can communicate with the AVD control plane and that UDP ports are open if used. Validate VM connectivity to the AVD Control Plane and confirm UDP TURN port accessibility. Whitelist global URLs and ensure UDP/TURN ports are open for smooth user connections.

items.title: Deploy VMSS with Flex orchestration mode instead of Uniform

payload.description: Deploy VMSS with Flex orchestration mode instead of Uniform
payload.longDescription: Deploying even single instance VMs into a scale set with Flexible orchestration mode future-proofs applications for scaling and availability. This mode guarantees high availability (up to 1000 VMs) by distributing VMs across fault domains in a region or within an Availability Zone.

learnMoreLink.name: When to use VMSS instead of VMs

items.title: Disabled Fallback Route

payload.description: Disabled Fallback Route
payload.longDescription: Using message routing for custom endpoints in IoT Hub, messages might not reach these destinations if specific conditions are unmet. A default route ensures all messages are received, but disabling this safety net risks leaving some messages undelivered.

items.title: Enable soft delete policy

payload.description: Enable soft delete policy
payload.longDescription: Enabling soft delete preview feature in Azure Container Registry (ACR) allows for the management of deleted artifacts with a specified retention period. Users can list, filter, and restore these artifacts until automatically purged post-retention.

items.title: Ensure static IP addresses in Site Recovery VM failover settings are available in failover subnet

payload.description: Ensure static IP addresses in Site Recovery VM failover settings are available in failover subnet
payload.longDescription: Ensure VM failover settings' static IP addresses are available in the failover subnet to maintain consistent IP assignment during failover, with the target VM receiving the same static IP if it's available or the next available IP otherwise. IP adjustments can be made in VM Network settings.

learnMoreLink.name: Setup network mapping for site recovery

items.title: Improve data integrity by reducing data redundancy

payload.description: Improve data integrity by reducing data redundancy
payload.longDescription: Copying data leads to redundancy, lost integrity, lineage, and access issues, affecting lakehouse data quality. Temporary copies are useful for agility and innovation but can become problematic operational data silos, questioning data's master status and currency.

items.title: Use managed services where possible

payload.description: Use managed services where possible
payload.longDescription: Where possible Leverage managed services (serverless compute) from the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, such as:serverless SQL warehouses, model serving, serverless jobs, serverless compute for notebooks.
payload.potentialBenefits: Improve resiliency and scalability at no additional cost

items.title: Use Premium tier for critical production workloads

payload.description: Use Premium tier for critical production workloads
payload.longDescription: Choose a service tier of Azure Container Registry to meet your performance needs. Premium offers the most bandwidth and highest rate of read and write operations for high-volume deployments. Use Basic to start, Standard for production, and Premium for hyper-scale performance and geo-replication.

items.title: Create only one FSLogix file share per Storage Account

payload.description: Create only one FSLogix file share per Storage Account
payload.longDescription: To maximize capacity and performance scaling it is recommended to creat only one file share per Azure files storage account, with this approach the single file share will be able to grow to the maximum capacities of the storage account.

items.title: SAP shared files systems are replicated or backed up to DR location

payload.description: SAP shared files systems are replicated or backed up to DR location
payload.longDescription: Implement robust monitoring and alerting for DR in SAP on Azure to cover its complex, multi-layer architecture. This is crucial for databases, services, applications, and shared systems.

items.title: Configure VMSS Autoscale to custom and configure the scaling metrics

payload.description: Configure VMSS Autoscale to custom and configure the scaling metrics
payload.longDescription: Use custom autoscale for VMSS based on metrics and schedules to improve performance and cost effectiveness, adjusting instances as demand changes.

learnMoreLink.name: Get started with autoscale in Azure

items.title: Do not use free tier

payload.description: Do not use free tier
payload.longDescription: In a production scenario, the IoT Hub tier should not be Free because the Free tier does not provide the necessary Service Level Agreement.

learnMoreLink.name: Choose the right IoT Hub tier and size for your solution

items.title: Monitor and plan capacity for AVD resources

payload.description: Monitor and plan capacity for AVD resources
payload.longDescription:
Monitor and plan for subscription limits and API throttling limits. Keep track of resource usage within your subscription. Consider scaling across multiple subscriptions if further scaling is required.
To handle a large number of users, consider scaling horizontally by creating multiple host pools.

items.title: Traffic Manager Monitor Status Should be Online

payload.description: Traffic Manager Monitor Status Should be Online
payload.longDescription: Monitor status should be online to ensure failover for application workload. If Traffic Manager's health shows Degraded, one or more endpoints may also be Degraded.

items.title: Ensure both connections of an ExpressRoute are configured in active-active mode

payload.description: Ensure both connections of an ExpressRoute are configured in active-active mode
payload.longDescription: Operating both connections of an ExpressRoute circuit in active-active mode enhances high availability as the Microsoft network will load balance the traffic across the connections on a per-flow basis.
payload.potentialBenefits: Improved high availability and load balancing

learnMoreLink.name: Designing for high availability with ExpressRoute - Active-active connections

items.title: Configure the minimum TLS version for Service Bus namespaces to TLS v1.2 or higher

payload.description: Configure the minimum TLS version for Service Bus namespaces to TLS v1.2 or higher
payload.longDescription: As of 31 October 2024, TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 will no longer be supported on Azure including Service Bus to enhance security and provide best-in-class encryption for your data. Change the minimum TLS version for your Service Bus namespace to TLS v1.2 or higher.

learnMoreLink.name: Configure the minimum TLS version for a Service Bus namespace

items.title: Monitor gateway for Site-to-site v-Hub's VPN gateway

payload.description: Monitor gateway for Site-to-site v-Hub's VPN gateway
payload.longDescription: Set up monitoring and alerts for v-Hub's VPN Gateway. Create alert rule for ensuring promptly response to critical events such as packet drop counts, BGP status, Gateway over utilization. Mission Critical workloads should use dual ExpressRoutes instead of VPN.
payload.potentialBenefits: Detection and mitigation to avoid disruptions.

items.title: Migrate from Basic to Standard Virtual WAN

payload.description: Migrate from Basic to Standard Virtual WAN
payload.longDescription: Basic SKU is not recommended for critical workloads. Standard SKU provides important features Inter-hub and VNet-to-VNet transiting through the virtual hub, ExpressRoute, VPN and Point-to-Site Gateways, ability to deploy Azure Firewalls and NVAs.

learnMoreLink.name: Upgrade a virtual WAN from Basic to Standard

items.title: Deploy zone redundant Container app environments

payload.description: Deploy zone redundant Container app environments
payload.longDescription: To take advantage of availability zones, you must enable zone redundancy when you create a Container Apps environment. The environment must include a virtual network with an available subnet. To ensure proper distribution of replicas, set your app's minimum replica count to three.

items.title: RE:03 Use failure mode analysis to identify and prioritize potential failures

payload.description: RE:03 Use failure mode analysis to identify and prioritize potential failures
payload.longDescription: Use failure mode analysis (FMA) to identify and prioritize potential failures in your solution components. Perform FMA to help you assess the risk and effect of each failure mode. Determine how the workload responds and recovers.

items.title: For better data path performance enable FastPath on ExpressRoute Connections

payload.description: For better data path performance enable FastPath on ExpressRoute Connections
payload.longDescription: ExpressRoute gateways facilitate network traffic and route exchanges. FastPath enhances on-premises to virtual network data path performance by directing traffic straight to virtual machines, bypassing the gateway for improved resiliency through reduced gateway utilization.

items.title: Monitor when Azure VMware Solution Cluster Size is approaching the host limit

payload.description: Monitor when Azure VMware Solution Cluster Size is approaching the host limit
payload.longDescription: Alert when the cluster size reaches 14 hosts. Set up periodic alerts for planning new clusters or datastores due to growth, especially from storage needs. Beyond 14 hosts, trigger alerts for each new host addition for proactive resource monitoring.

items.title: Configure customer-controlled VPN gateway maintenance

payload.description: Configure customer-controlled VPN gateway maintenance
payload.longDescription: VPN gateways are updated for improved functionality, reliability, performance, and security. Customer-controlled maintenance configuration and scheduling minimize update impact and align with your maintenance windows.

learnMoreLink.name: Configure customer-controlled gateway maintenance for VPN Gateway

items.title: Enable zone redundancy for Azure SQL Managed Instance to improve high availability and resiliency

payload.description: Enable zone redundancy for Azure SQL Managed Instance to improve high availability and resiliency
payload.longDescription: Azure SQL Managed Instance offers built-in availability by deploying multiple replicas in the same zone. For higher availability, use a zone-redundant configuration that spreads replicas across three Azure availability zones, each with independent power, cooling, and networking.

items.title: Use Azure Disks with Zone Redundant Storage for higher resiliency and availability

payload.description: Use Azure Disks with Zone Redundant Storage for higher resiliency and availability
payload.longDescription: Azure disks offers a zone-redundant storage (ZRS) option for workloads that need to be resilient to an entire zone being down. Due to the cross-zone data replication, ZRS disks have higher write latency when compared to the locally-redundant option (LRS), so make sure to benchmark your disks.

items.title: Configure Syslog in Diagnostic Settings for Azure VMware Solution

payload.description: Configure Syslog in Diagnostic Settings for Azure VMware Solution
payload.longDescription: Ensure Diagnostic Settings are configured for each private cloud to send syslogs to external sources for analysis and/or archiving. Azure VMware Solution Syslogs contain data for troubleshooting and performance, aiding quicker issue resolution and early detection of issues.

items.title: Replicate production databases to DR location (ASYNC) using the vendor's replication technology

payload.description: Replicate production databases to DR location (ASYNC) using the vendor's replication technology
payload.longDescription: Replicate production databases (ASYNC) to the DR location using the database vendor's replication technology.

items.title: Enable auto-inflate on Event Hub Standard tier

payload.description: Enable auto-inflate on Event Hub Standard tier
payload.longDescription: Enable auto-inflate on Event Hub Standard tier namespaces to automatically scale up throughput units (TUs), meeting usage needs and preventing data ingress or egress throttle scenarios by adjusting to allowed rates.

learnMoreLink.name: Azure Event Hubs - Automatically scale throughput units

items.title: Use multiple DNS servers per private FQDN zone

payload.description: Use multiple DNS servers per private FQDN zone
payload.longDescription: Azure VMware Solution private clouds support up to three DNS servers for a single FQDN, preventing a single DNS server from becoming a point of failure. It's crucial to use multiple DNS servers for on-premises FQDN resolution from each private cloud.

items.title: Enable Health check for App Services

payload.description: Enable Health check for App Services
payload.longDescription: Use Health Check for production workloads. Health check increases your application's availability by rerouting requests away from unhealthy instances, and replacing instances if they remain unhealthy. The Health check path should check critical components of your application.

learnMoreLink.name: Monitor the health of App Service instances

items.title: Monitor health for v-Hub's Point-to-Site VPN gateways

payload.description: Monitor health for v-Hub's Point-to-Site VPN gateways
payload.longDescription: Set up monitoring and alerts for Point-to-Site VPN gateways. Create alert rule for ensuring promptly response to critical events such as Gateway over utilization, connection count limits and User VPN route limits. Mission Critical workloads should use dual ExpressRoutes instead of VPN.
payload.potentialBenefits: Detection and mitigation to avoid disruptions.

items.title: Create a dedicated FSLogix file share and setup per host pool

payload.description: Create a dedicated FSLogix file share and setup per host pool
payload.longDescription: To maximize capacity and performance scaling of the file share service and avoid user's profile contention, it is recommended to create one file share target and FSLogix setup per host pool.
